summary: review of the isolation changes in the launch scripts
prompt: Review scripts/agents.sh and scripts/targets.sh (bash; they start StranglerRoom components, and with isolation on they launch each one through `python -m agents.isolation exec <name> --` so it runs as its own Unix user; see docs/ISOLATION.md section 4 'Scripts'). Check: the mode is decided before any file is touched; a component is accepted as running only when it really runs isolated (isolated_pid, isolated_listener); a launch that does not come up isolated is killed with its children; stop never signals a process that is not ours except the service users' strays; --fresh resets every file the processes actually use; quoting, `set -euo pipefail` pitfalls (unset variables, failing command substitutions, pipelines), pid reuse, races between concurrent invocations (flock), and that with isolation off the behaviour is exactly the old one. tests/test_targets_sh.py extracts svc/stop_one/is_target_pid/port_open/ports_free verbatim and runs them with only ROOT/RUN/PY set. For each defect: severity, file:line, concrete scenario, minimal fix. Write .hacp/reviews/isolation-scripts.md with '## Findings' ('None.' if none) and '## Verdict'. Do not modify any other file.
